artifacts.summary: The dovetailing argument is compiled as a theorem over an arbitrary finite graph (forward-only sufficiency for the compiled certificate); the full sufficiency claim is refuted for the compiled relation by a three-state snce fixture (backward arm only); the repair cohBi (adding the strict-since link) makes the certificate sufficient at the label level, at no cost on snce-free closures; the |R| bound is derived and consumed by nothing.

next_steps: Plan: adopt cohBi as Route B's relation and pin realizes_of_certAdm_cohBi / sufficiency_refuted as Challenge statements; next fixture must carry both an untl and a snce member; state that sufficiency is label-level and name the semantic step as the remaining adequacy obligation.

memory_candidates.content: A dovetailing/run construction over a finite coherence graph needs, per eventuality, a discharge path AND a one-step link (carried at v implies delivered or carried on under the guard at every successor). A relation with the link in one temporal direction only yields sufficiency for that direction only; the product-layer linkPred has the untl arm and no snce arm, and Probe815.sufficiency_refuted is the compiled three-state counterexample. L-layer propagation lemmas (snce_propagates_to_start) carry the link inside LocalCoherentSeq and cannot be cited at a layer whose relation lacks the clause.
